versions.changelog:
Initial release of godfery-transcribe (openai-whisper):

- Provides speech-to-text (STT) transcription using SkillBoss API Hub powered by Whisper and other models.
- Supports both standard transcription and audio translation to English via API.
- No local installation or model download required; API key needed.
- Includes Python quick start example for easy integration.
- Returns transcription in the API response under result["result"]["text"].
